title: Heat Pump
description: Clock-synced sidechain ducking: hold + log release
text:
Clock-synced sidechain ducking envelope: on each division the CV ducks, holds briefly, then recovers with a logarithmic release.

#### Patching
- Patch **CV Out** to a filter or VCA
- **MIDI CC** mirrors when Out is enabled

#### Faders
- **Main** — Release speed
- **Shift + fader** — Depth
- **Button + fader** — Clock division

#### Buttons
- **Short tap** — One manual duck
- **Long press** — Mute without snapping to idle
- **Shift + long** — Toggle invert

channels.faderDescription: Log recovery after hold.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Button + fader picks clock division.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Duck amount per division.
channels.fnDescription: Short = manual duck; Long = mute.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + long toggles invert.

title: Grooves
description: Multi-genre MIDI drum grooves with feel
text:
One-channel multi-genre drum helper with up to seven MIDI voices, clock-synced in 4/4.

#### Parameters
- **Groove** — Genre family
- **Density** and **Feel** — Fills and character
- **Drummer** — Personas (long press); ornament style
- **Swing max %** — Caps swing depth (sign = direction)

#### Jack
- **Any/Stacked** — CV out
- **CV in** — Density, Feel, or Reset

#### Architecture
- Clock-driven scheduling in a dedicated processor
- MIDI sends in a separate task (`pending_*` isolation)

channels.faderDescription: Reveals extra drum hits as ghosts.

channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Scrub pattern families.
channels.fnDescription: Short: downbeat. Long: mute.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse swing. Long: Any vs Stacked.

title: Echolot
description: MIDI/CV delay with feedback and pitch shift
text:
MIDI/CV delay with feedback, mix, and optional pitch shift on each repeat.

#### Behavior
- Feedback and optional pitch intervals on repeats
- **I/O** — MIDI/CV routing
- **Ping-Pong** — Alternates MIDI Out A/B (MIDI→MIDI and CV→MIDI)
- **Mute** — Ring-out (block new input; queue plays out)
- **Long Panic** — Clears the trail — **Third** interval edits never panic that hold
- **MIDI In** — Always flashes white for diagnosis when muted

#### Faders
- **Main** — Delay (up = shorter / faster)

#### Buttons
- **Long** — Panic (clear queue); skipped if **Third** used this hold

#### LEDs
- White flash on MIDI/gate in (~20% when muted)
- Ping-Pong: Top = Out A · Bottom = Out B

#### Params
- **Routing** — Single / Ping-Pong

channels.faderDescription: Delay time or clock division.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Latch layers.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Pitch shift per repeat.
channels.fnDescription: Short mute; long clears buffer.

title: Control Issues
description: Shape CV and send it as MIDI control
text:
Control Issues shapes CV (linear, log, exp, S-curve, rectify, fold) and sends MIDI CC or NRPN. Supports slew, quantization, and gate or continuous input modes.

#### Cheatsheet
- 1-channel CV→MIDI sculptor
- Defaults are transparent: +100 % att, 0 offset, 0 slew, Linear, full CC window, 100 Hz
- **Gate mode** — Schmitt threshold (0.1 V hysteresis), then the same pipeline
- **Mute** — sends Output Min once and goes silent; unmute resends the live value
- Watch the **button LED** for level — fader LEDs stay dark
- Uses clock ticker only (no `CLOCK_PUBSUB`); no clock → no downbeat blink

#### Faders
- **Main** — Attenuverter −100…+100 % (center deadband = 0)

#### Buttons
- **Shift+Hold** — momentary Bypass (keeps Range / Min-Max / Rate)

#### Params and LEDs
- Button LED only: **Main** = app color × out; **Alt** = red × |offset|; **Third** = cyan × slew (floor so hue stays visible at 0)

channels.jackDescription: Bipolar or unipolar CV in; shaped value as MIDI CC/NRPN.
channels.faderDescription: Main fader controls shaping parameters per latch layer.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mute; long bypass.

title: Venn
description: Dual Euclidean layers + boolean logic; scale-aware melody via Extent
text:
Two independent Euclidean masks combined with boolean logic — the OXI GEN dual-layer idea with a scale-aware melodic line. Color sets Layer A; Layer B LEDs use a fixed complement. Btn1 shows logic mode, not Color. Different lengths per layer enable polyrhythmic XOR/AND patterns Euclid cannot make alone.

#### Melody
- **Note A** — degree 0 of the device quantizer key
- **Extent** — arch span in scale degrees through Length-A
- **Interval B** — diatonic steps above that line for Ch2 (wire indices 0–12 unchanged)
- Extent 0 = monotone Note A
- Venn always draws its degrees from the device Scale

#### Clock and probability
- Needs clock
- **Prob %** < 100 adds optional flakiness; 100 is fully deterministic
- No pitch CV (use GenSeq for that)

#### Follow device tonic
- Default **on** — hold the Scene button and move Fader 5 and both lines transpose, together with Bassment, Contura, Chord Vamp and Arp de Lévy
- Pitch class comes from the device; octave stays with MIDI Note A
- Change lands at the start of the next A-cycle, not mid-pattern

#### Faders
- **Main** — F0 pulses A · F1 pulses B (density; absolute pulse count, Bjorklund redistributes)

#### Buttons
- **Shift+Btn2** — Toggle post-logic invert (shadow); white↔none fade like Heat Pump

title: Manifold
description: One CV in, three shaped outs with comparator modes
text:
One CV in, three shaped outs. Each out is independently CV, Gate, or Trigger: CV gets attenuverter / offset / slew; Gate and Trigger get threshold / hysteresis / pulse length.

#### On-device mode and range
- **Long press** on channels 1–3 cycles that out through CV → Gate → Trigger; stored as a parameter (configurator stays in sync)
- **Shift + long press** on an out cycles output range; button flashes once for ±5 V or twice for 0–10 V
- **Channel 0** — short tap freezes conditioned input
- **Channels B/C/D** — short tap mutes

#### Internal LFO (unpatched input)
- With nothing patched, channel 0 becomes a morphing LFO and drives B/C/D after the jack has been still ~1.2 s
- Movement on the jack switches back to CV in
- Same wave engine as Super LFO: **Main** = speed, **Alt** = morph, **Third** = skew on channel 0 fader layers
- **Shift + short press** — clock sync
- **LFO Speed** param moves the whole rate range down to Slow or Slowest

#### MIDI mirroring
- All four waves mirror to MIDI: conditioned input on channel 0 plus outs B, C, D
- Channel 0 and any out in **CV mode** always send CC
- On Gate or Trigger outs, **Mode Map** can switch a lane to **Note**: one bit per out (B bit 0, C bit 1, D bit 2); Note On/Off on edges; pitch from that lane’s **CC Map** slot (7-bit note number)
- **Mode Map** 0 — every lane on CC (legacy)

#### MIDI channel and CC maps
- Default: share base **MIDI Channel**; CC numbers = **MIDI CC** + 0…3
- **Ch Map** — one nibble per wave (wave 0 bits 0–3, wave 1 bits 4–7, …); value + 1 = MIDI channel 1…16
- **CC Map** — 7 bits per wave (wave 0 bits 0–6, wave 1 bits 7–13, …); CC number directly (or note number when **Mode Map** selects Note for that lane)
- Map of **0** means “all waves follow the base” (shipped default, bit-for-bit old behaviour)
- Example **Ch Map**: channels 1, 5, 9, 13 → nibbles 0, 4, 8, 12 → 0 + 4·16 + 8·256 + 12·4096 = **51 264**
- Example **CC Map**: CCs 20, 21, 40, 41 → 20 + 21·128 + 40·16384 + 41·2097152 = **86 641 300**
- CC Map field is seven bits wide (CC 0–127 only); in NRPN mode the base CC still spans full 14-bit range — a mapped one does not

#### LEDs
- Five equidistant hues: blue through violet and red to orange, one per operating mode
- Channel 0 blue while CV in feeds outs; one step warmer once internal LFO takes over
- Outs take remaining three steps by mode — CV, Gate, Trigger in orange — mode swap visible when it lands
- All four channels dim with signal amplitude

title: Ripppple
description: Root CV or LFO through three cumulative waveshapers
text:
Ripppple is a cumulative waveshaper chain, not four independent LFOs.

#### Channel 0 (root)
- Jack is a CV input with attenuverter conditioning — **Main** trims, **Alt** offsets, **Third** slews
- When the jack has been static for about 1.2 s the input falls back to an internal morphing LFO; jack movement switches back to CV in immediately
- With internal LFO, the same three fader layers become speed, morph and skew
- Short tap freezes the root value — the value itself, so stepped morph nodes hold too
- **Shift** + short tap toggles clock sync while the internal LFO runs

#### Channels 1–3 (stages)
- No oscillators of their own — each stage waveshapes the cumulative result of everything before it: B shapes the root, C shapes B’s output, D shapes C’s output
- Jacks and MIDI CCs mirror that chain — what you hear on output D has passed through every preceding stage
- Stage faders are always **Main** = amount, **Alt** = offset, **Third** = slew
- At amount zero, **Fold** passes through at unity gain; **Soft** and **Rect** blend from dry input towards their curve
- Long press cycles that stage’s process through Fold → Soft → Rect — same three choices as params **Process B**, **Process C** and **Process D** in the configurator (start value; follows a live long press)
- **Shift** + long press cycles output range ±5 V ↔ 0–10 V; button flashes once for ±5 V or twice for 0–10 V
- Short tap mutes with a click-free ramp
- Moving the fader while the button is held scrubs the **Third** layer and cancels a pending mute or process cycle on release

#### LEDs
- Top and bottom form a bipolar display of each stage’s cumulative output
- Five equidistant hues separate operating modes: channel 0 is one hue for CV in and another while the internal LFO drives it; channels 1–3 take the hue of their active process — Fold, Soft or Rect
- Button LEDs on channels 1–3 breathe with the stage output even while **Shift** is held
- Muted channels dim heavily and their button LED goes dark; channel 0’s button stays bright while the chain is frozen
- All four channels can mirror their level as MIDI CC or NRPN, using the base CC plus the channel offset

#### Ch Map and CC Map
- **Ch Map** holds one nibble per wave — wave 0 in bits 0–3, wave 1 in bits 4–7, and so on — where stored nibble + 1 is MIDI channel 1–16
- **CC Map** holds one 7-bit field per wave in the same order, wave *w* at bits 7·*w* to 7·*w*+6, giving each wave its own CC number 0–127
- Map value **0** as a whole means “follow the base”: **Ch Map** 0 sends every wave on the **MIDI Channel** param; **CC Map** 0 keeps the old base-CC-plus-offset derivation; both default to 0 — untouched Ripppple behaves as before
- Example — channels: root on 1, stage B on 10, other two on 16 → nibbles 0, 9, 15, 15 → `0 + 9·16 + 15·256 + 15·4096 = 65 424`
- Example — CCs 20, 21, 40, 41 → `20 + 21·128 + 40·16384 + 41·2 097 152 = 86 641 300`
- A **CC Map** field is seven bits wide (CC 0–127 only); in NRPN mode the base CC still spans the full 14-bit range, but a mapped one does not

title: Dit Dah
description: ITU Morse phrase player with 16th-quantized note-ons
text:
Dit Dah plays packed ASCII Morse phrases as MIDI notes, quantized so each dit/dah starts on a 16th.

#### Clock and transport
- Needs clock: MIDI Start/Reset or the first 16th after ticks appear arms playback (analog clock on Atom/Meteor/Cube has no transport)
- After arming, the phrase loops without waiting for bar resets
- Stop silences everything

#### Jack
- One CV jack — modes: CV Out Gate, CV Out Pitch (0–10 V, V/Oct), CV In Gate (±5 V rising edge arms like long press), or CV In Dit length / Pitch offset / Dah interval
- CV In destinations add ±5 V bipolar on top of the saved fader at playback — not written to storage
- Unpatched ±5 V ≈ centre, so no change
- MIDI notes always fire

#### Faders
- **Main** — dit length from a 30 ms floor up to four 16ths of the current tick; dahs last three dits
- **Alt** — transposes the whole phrase
- **Third** (deadzone) — adds the **Dah interval** param only onto dahs
- ITU gaps (1 / 3 / 7) stay; invert only swaps tone lengths and flips the fader mappings at playback

#### Button
- Short press — mutes (**Button LED** off)
- **Shift** + short — toggles texture: random MIDI velocity and swing on odd 16ths (**Bottom LED** white)
- Long press — retriggers; arms the next 16th like CV In Gate
- **Shift** + long — inverts dit↔dah and flips speed/pitch at playback (**Button LED** white when unmuted; orange when normal)
- **Phrase 1** defaults to SOS

channels.jackDescription: CV Out Gate / CV Out Pitch (0–10 V V/Oct), CV In Gate (±5 V rising edge arms like long press), or CV In Dit length / Pitch offset / Dah interval (±5 V bipolar add at playback only). MIDI notes always fire.
channels.faderDescription: Duration of a dit in milliseconds, from 30 ms up to four 16th-notes of the incoming clock. Dah is 3× dit.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Adds the Interval param onto dahs only (deadzone around centre). Dits stay on the Alt-offset pitch.

channels.ledBottom: White when texture is on; off when texture is off
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift+short toggles texture (random MIDI velocity + odd-16th swing). Shift+long inverts dit↔dah and flips speed/pitch at playback.

title: Maniac Bounce
description: Delay with bounce pitch and velocity LFO
text:
One-channel MIDI/CV delay with dry-through, bounce pitch, and a velocity LFO on dry notes and repeats. Free-running millisecond delay only — no clock sync.

#### Delay and bounce
- **Main** sets delay time and echo retention together — fader up = shorter and decays faster; down = slower with more hops
- **Alt** sets bounce interval bipolar ±24 semitones (default about +6 st); each repeat alternates +interval / −interval
- Each note auto-gates to about half the frozen delay period
- A new **NoteOn** on the same pitch kills the prior chain for that pitch (poly with same-pitch kill)
- **NoteOff** does not kill the trail

#### Velocity LFO
- **Third** sets Vel LFO rate and depth coupled (up = faster and deeper)
- Modulates velocity on every note including the immediate dry hit
- In MIDI→CV Gate mode the same LFO shapes gate pulse width instead

#### Jack
- MIDI or CV in/out per **I/O** mode — dry through plus bouncing repeats

#### Buttons
- **Short** — Mute new input while the trail rings out
- **Long** — Panic (clear queue + **NoteOff**s); skipped if you are holding **Third** (Vel LFO) this press
- White button flash on input

#### LEDs
- Top / bottom — activity and bounce-interval feedback

channels.jackDescription: MIDI or CV in, MIDI or CV out per I/O mode. Dry through plus bouncing repeats.
channels.faderDescription: Repeat spacing. Fader up is shorter and decays faster; down is slower with more hops.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Rate and depth together on dry hits and repeats. MIDI→CV Gate uses the same LFO for pulse width.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Each repeat alternates +interval / −interval, ±24 semitones.
channels.fnDescription: Short mute (ring-out). Long panic unless you were editing Third.

title: Golden Gate
description: Fibonacci-spaced gates — successive ratios approach φ
text:
One-channel gate / pitch generator whose hit spacing comes from the Fibonacci sequence (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, …). Successive Fibonacci ratios converge on φ (≈ 1.618), so deeper gaps feel increasingly “golden” — still whole-number steps, not continuous φ timing by default.

#### Rhythm shape
- Shallow **depth** — denser, more regular hits
- Deeper Fibonacci values — larger holes; same cycle feels sparser and more asymmetric
- **Reverse** plays the gaps of this filled cycle backwards (not the whole table from its largest value)

#### Pitch and MIDI
- Pitch modes: jack carries **1V/oct**; MIDI sends related notes in parallel
- Chromatic Fibonacci intervals (12-TET) or near-φ intervals (~833 cents × gap)
- MIDI: nearest note + pitch bend (±2 semitone bend range assumed)

#### Clock and jack
- Needs a running clock
- Jack: **Gate Out**, **Pitch Out**, or **CV In** for depth / cycle / reset modulation
- Note and CC modes: gate pulse; pitch modes: 1V/oct CV

#### Faders
- **Main** — Fibonacci depth (how far into 1, 1, 2, 3, 5 … 89 the gaps go)
- **Alt** — Cycle length (about 8–128 steps before wrap)
- **Third** — Local speed grid (same divisions as Heat Pump: 1/1 … 1/32; up = faster; overrides the **Speed** parameter)

#### Buttons
- **Short** — Reset / restart at the downbeat
- **Long** — Mute (do not move the fader while holding)
- **Shift + short** — Reverse this cycle’s gaps
- **Shift + long** — Cycle output mode: Note → CC → 12-TET pitch → φ pitch

#### LEDs
- **Top** — Progress through the cycle (app color)
- **Top + Shift** — Cycle length (red)
- **Top + Third** — Speed division: cyan = straight, yellow = dotted, orange = triplet
- **Bottom** — Flash on each hit

title: Super LFO
description: Morphing dual-osc LFO with CV form control
text:
Dual-osc morphing LFO.

#### Channels
- **Ch0** — Morph / Amp / Skew on CV In
- **Ch1** — Symmetry / Speed / Warp on CV Out
- **Ch0 Shift + Short** — Cycle **CV Dest**
- **Ch1 Shift + Long** — Toggle clock sync (**Grid Lock**)

#### Mute and freeze
- **Freeze** — Holds the wave
- **In-mute** — Silences CV in
- **Out-mute** — Silences output

#### Mix
- **Mix balance** — 0–100% (**Xfade** only)

#### Jack routing
- **Ch0** jack = CV In
- **Ch1** jack = CV Out

channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Rate (or clock division when Grid Lock).
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Nonlinear phase distortion.
channels.fnDescription: Short: reset phase. Long: out-mute.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse. Long: clock sync toggle.

title: Arp de Lévy
description: Lévy-flight generative arpeggiator — evolve, texture, and expression
text:
Arp de Lévy is a one-channel generative arpeggiator with a persistent note pool and Lévy-flight steps — mostly small melodic moves, occasionally a larger jump — so the phrase evolves without white-noise pitch.

#### Output
- CV (1V/oct, quantized unless **Bypass quantizer**) and MIDI note fire together on each hit
- **V/Oct** selects Eurorack 1V/oct or Buchla 1.2V/oct scaling

#### Mutation rate & texture
- **Mutation rate** freezes the pool at the bottom and applies more Lévy edits at each phrase boundary as you raise it
- **Texture** jointly moves density, phrase length (16 steps down to 4), and swing

#### Controls
- **Button + Fader** sets Lévy α (local ↔ wild jumps)
- **Short press** (and **CV Dest** = Reroll) re-rolls the pool and picks a new expression depth for velocity and gate jitter
- **Long press** mutes
- **Shift + short** reverses playback (on CV Out, cycles Pitch / Gate / Velocity)
- **Shift + long** cycles octave span 1–4

#### Clock & CV
- Needs clock
- **Jack** selects CV Out or CV In (Evolve, Texture, Reroll)
- **Follow device tonic** transposes the pool with the global Tonic fader

#### Cheatsheet — Octave LED
- Blue · Cyan · Yellow · Red

channels.jackDescription: Jack mode selects Pitch CV out or CV in (Evolve / Texture / Reroll). MIDI note fires in parallel unless muted.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly the note pool Lévy-walks at each phrase boundary. Bottom = frozen loop.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Flight character — low = local steps, high = wild jumps.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: One macro for density (rests), phrase length (from 16 steps down to 4), and swing.
channels.fnDescription: Short press: new note pool, new expression depth (vel/gate jitter), restart phrase. Long press: mute.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse playback. Long: cycle octave span 1–4.

title: Chord Vamp
description: Chord progressions — perform, shift+tap capture, or auto vamp
text:
Chord Vamp plays MIDI chord progressions in two modes: **Perform** and **Auto**.

#### Perform mode
- Scrub a **pitch map** of the genre’s unique degrees across ~3 octaves and **hold** the button to sound the chord
- **Perform long press** is unused — the chord stays held while the button is down

#### Auto mode
- A genre **rhythm phrase** (weighted hits + multi-bar rests) loops on the clock while harmony **Repeats** or **Meanders**
- **Short press** play/pauses
- **Long press** clears the capture clip and reseeds the genre phrase
- **Shift + long press** panic
- **Shift + short press** returns to Perform

#### Mode switching
- Toggle modes with **Shift + short press**
- In Perform, **Shift + short press** switches to Auto and starts playback
- If the always-record ring has chords, it also commits the last N bars (per **Capture length**) into a timed clip
- If the ring is empty, Auto runs the **genre phrase** instead

#### Feel & swing
- **Feel** (Button + Fader) scales Auto hit lengths and Capture playback durations
- **Swing** (scene storage, genre-seeded) delays odd 16ths; resets when you pick/reseed a genre

#### Jack
- Folds CV Out, CV In Macro, and CV In Panic into one enum
- Macro modulates scrub (Perform) or tension (Auto)
- Panic fires All Notes Off from CV

#### Cheatsheet — Faders
- Shared axis: Dub → Disco → House → Techno → Trip-Hop → Hip-Hop → Jungle → UK Garage → Dubstep

#### Cheatsheet — Jack params
- One enum — a CV In destination and CV Out were never live at once, and the freed slot is what lets Vamp grow

#### Cheatsheet — Params
- **Follow device tonic** (default on)

channels.jackDescription: CV Out: chord root pitch while held/sounding (0V idle). CV In Macro or CV In Panic.
channels.faderDescription: Perform: pitch map (genre degrees × 3 octaves). Auto: Meander tension.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Laid back ↔ advanced hit length (Capture durs scale too). Rests unchanged.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Cycle genre preset (Capture clip slot when a timed clip exists).
channels.fnDescription: Perform: hold for chord. Auto: short = play/pause. Long (Auto): clear clip / reseed.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: toggle Perform↔Auto; Perform+Shift+short = capture. Long (Auto): panic.

title: Hold Sam
description: Clocked sample & hold to MIDI note/CC
text:
Hold Sam samples CV on clock ticks and sends MIDI note or CC. Bottom LED shows a spectrum meter of the held value.

#### Operation
- Clocked sample-and-hold
- Capture on division or **Shift + Short**
- **Main** shapes gate length or CC depth
- **Long** (no fader move) soft-mutes so notes can ring out
- **Third** sets how strongly velocity follows the sample

#### Cheatsheet — Buttons
- **Long** (no fader move) — Soft mute (fade; no hard note-off)

#### Cheatsheet — Params / LEDs
- Layer meters: IR→UV spectrum on Main/Alt/Third fader

channels.jackDescription: Bipolar or unipolar CV to sample on each clock tick.
channels.faderDescription: Scales and inverts incoming CV before quantize.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes MIDI output.

title: Harmonica
description: Monophonic root in → chord MIDI out
text:
Harmonica outputs chord MIDI from a single root input — not a polyphonic keyboard input.

#### Harmony
- One root (last MIDI note or pitch CV) picks the chord root
- The fader picks chord type: Unison · Power · Min · Maj · Sus4 · Min7 · Dom7 · Maj7 · Min9 · Add9
- Up to four MIDI voices sound (MIDI→CV follows the highest)

#### Controls
- **Alt** sets inversion (0–2) or open top
- **Mute** is a short tap — use **Third** (button + fader) for velocity so mute and vel don’t collide
- **Alt + Short** cycles harmony octave
- **Alt + Long** walks voicing presets (tight/dry → wide/slow)

#### CV & gate
- **CV Gate**: Sustain, fixed ms, or clock divisions
- Near-0V CV = rest; unpatched float stays silent until a stable pitch

channels.jackDescription: MIDI or CV root in; up to four MIDI chord voices out (MIDI→CV follows highest)
channels.faderDescription: Unison through Add9 (incl. Maj7 / Min9)
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: MIDI velocity for sounding voices
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Steps 0–2 = root / 1st / 2nd inversion; step 3 = open top
channels.fnDescription: Short mute; Alt+Short harmony octave; Alt+Long voicing preset

title: Loop de Cay
description: Additive overdub loop with level decay
text:
Loop de Cay is a clocked overdub loop: play while armed to capture; each wrap applies **Alt** strength through the selected **Decay Mode** (0 = freeze forever).

#### Pitch & performance
- Pitch modes stay on the global scale
- **Random** jitters scale pitch and only lowers velocity
- **Gate** shortens duration toward a 16th floor
- Hold the button for long notes — mute is **Shift + Long**
- **Hold + Fader** glissandos through scale degrees toward the fader (Chord Vamp–style)

#### Length & decay
- Length is **Shift + Short** (1–8 bars), not Alt/Third
- **Third** picks **Decay Mode** (Configurator sync)
- Quantized to 16ths

#### Cheatsheet — Params / LEDs
- Capture/playback hit: sharp button 80% dim (~2 PPQN) + Top white
- Layer meters on Top/Bottom/Button

channels.jackDescription: Depends on Mode (Pitch→MIDI / Gate→MIDI use CV In; MIDI→CV / Fader→Both use CV Out)
channels.faderDescription: Span around Base Note; quantized to global scale. Pitch→MIDI adds it to the CV pitch as a transpose
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Seven zones IR→UV (Btn+Fader; gate modes while muted)
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: 0 = immortal; higher ≈ fewer wraps to silence
channels.fnDescription: Hold for note in gate modes; Hold+Fader = glissando.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + short = bars; Shift + long = mute/erase.

title: Bassment
description: Multi-genre monophonic basslines with bassist Voice personas
text:
Genre MIDI bass on the global clock (9 shared genres with Grooves / Chord Vamp — tropes live in `genre_palette::GENRE_PROG_8`). Notes sustain across empty 16ths until the next hit (legato when the pitch repeats).

#### Feel, density, and phrase form
- **Density** — reveals fill hits and freer scale degrees
- **Alt** — scrubs genre on the shared spectrum axis
- **Third** — Feel / Groove (swing, microtiming, velocity contrast, ghost drag, gate character — depth capped by Groove max %)
- Phrases are **8 bars** in AA B A′ form: rhythmic motif repeats, harmony walks the tropes
- Bars 5–6 answer (shifted, more approaches); bar 7 ornaments; bar 8 breathes (no ghosts/approaches)
- At higher Feel the line leaves “lock” mode: live Dice mix with the step-hash for approaches, ghosts, octave punches, and accent rake
- Pickups before downbeats; soft cores dropped for air; ghosts can become dead notes; approaches may be chromatic or scale-neighbor
- **Voice × genre** soft-bias: pocket players stay sparse in Jungle/UKG; busy voices thin in Dub/Techno

#### Gestures
- **Shift+Tap** — dedicated bass fill toward the *next* bar’s chord (leading tone on last hit), resolves on downbeat; Voice picks contour (walk / arp / octave push / pedal); pocket Voices and Dub lean Pedal
- At high Density, same gesture becomes a quiet **pedal break** (held root)
- **Shift+Hold** — register-lifted solo (+1 octave, +2 for Jaco/Claypool), breath gaps and shorter gates; re-rolls each bar while held; always resolves on next downbeat
- Button LED **white** for the gesture (dim = pedal break)
- **Long cycles** — bassist Voice personas forward in historical era order: Mingus → Jamerson → Bootsy → Jaco → Robbie → Flabba → Flea → Claypool (button flash = voice color); previous Voice lives in the Configurator
- **Swing Dir** — rides the sign of Groove max %
- Short mutes

#### CV, MIDI, and filter
- **CV Out** — pitch (V/Oct)
- **CV In** — modulates Density / Feel or triggers Reset
- **Filter CC** (0 = off; 74 is typical cutoff) tracks the line like velocities: genre brightness lerped along the shared spectrum (Dub and Dubstep deep, UK Garage and Jungle cutting), Voice bite on top (Jamerson and Robbie warm, Flea and Claypool bright), hit dynamics so accents open the filter
- Fills lift, solos bloom, pedal break ducks away
- MIDI note-ons and filter CC fire outside the clock subscriber (`pending_*` isolate), same pattern as Grooves

#### Follow device tonic and scale
- **Follow device tonic** (default on) — device Tonic is live transpose: hold Scene, move Fader 5; moves with Contura, Chord Vamp, Venn and Arp de Lévy; pitch class from device, octave of Root unchanged; new key on next bar line
- **Follow device scale** (default off) — same for Scale; left off, patch keeps its own (Scale is part of genre character)

#### Jack params
- One enum — a CV In destination and CV Out were never live at once
- **Groove max %** carries swing direction in its sign — negative swings offbeats early

#### Voices and LEDs
- **Flea** — Red: staccato + aggressive jumps
- **Claypool** — Yellow: quirky leaps + chromatic nudges

title: Contura
description: Melodic contour over selectable 12-TET scale sets, anchored to the device tonic
text:
Generates melodic contour phrases over selectable 12-TET pitch-class sets, anchored to the device quantizer tonic. Phrase starts and endings pull harder toward the tonic (cadence grammar); mid-phrase follows each set’s ScaleFeel. Needs a running clock.

#### Scale sets and ornaments
- Scale-set names are conventional labels for interval patterns (Western modes and other named collections on equal footing) — not claims about living musical practice or authentic intonation
- Scale feel drives brief ornaments — grace neighbours, turns or echoes — when the division leaves enough MIDI space (disabled on the finest grids)

#### Phrasing and gates
- Phrases mix short, medium, and longer note lengths
- Gates via MIDI note on/off

#### Jack and CV
- **Jack** = CV Out (pitch, 1V/oct) or CV In (Density / Interval / Reset / Phrase + CV Att), set in the Configurator
- CV on **Phrase** stretches and shortens the sentence, moving the contour arch and cadence with it

#### Follow device tonic and scale
- **Follow device tonic** (default on) — device Tonic is live transpose: hold Scene, move Fader 5; moves with Bassment, Chord Vamp, Venn and Arp de Lévy; note pool rebuilt on change so cadence resolves in the new key; effect at next phrase start
- **Follow device scale** (default off) — swaps Scale set for device Scale

channels.jackDescription: CV Out: quantized melodic pitch (1V/oct / range). CV In: modulates Density, Interval or Phrase, or Reset (gate) — Dest + Att in Configurator. Gate is MIDI note on/off.
channels.faderDescription: Max scale-degree step — bottom stepwise, mid already leaps, top wanders 2–3 octaves when octave span allows
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: How often notes fire vs rests — sparse ↔ continuous, mid already densifies
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: How many steps before the contour resets (3–28)
channels.fnDescription: Short press mutes/unmutes. Long press steps to the next scale set.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift+Short = octave span 1→4 · Shift+Long = previous scale set
channels.ledBottom: Pitch height within the current span

title: Giant Steps
description: Clock-driven chord sequencer over Coltrane tonal center geometry
text:
Clock-driven chord sequencer cycling through three tonal centers spaced by a configurable interval (default major 3rd).

#### Density and grid
- **Density** fader controls approach depth in 7 positions on a fixed 9-slot grid — three slots (ii, V, I) per center
- The I of each center always plays; raising the fader inserts one approach chord at a time — first the V of centers 1–3, then the ii of centers 1–3 — so the cycle grows 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 chords
- Empty slots aren’t silent — the previous chord sustains through them, so the cycle stays nine slots long at every density; sparse settings give a long held tonic
- Nine slots sit across 4/4 — cycle returns to a downbeat every nine bars on binary divisions and every three on triplet ones
- Chord qualities follow Coltrane convention: Maj7 on centers, Dom7 on dominants, m7 on subdominant approaches
- **Voicing** param sets close triad, 7th, drop-2 or quartal stacking; each chord is revoiced to move as little as possible from the one before it

#### Button and CV
- Tap — mutes, cutting anything still held
- Hold — toggles reverse
- **Shift** + tap — resets the cycle to step 0
- **Shift** + hold — cycles interval through minor 3rd, major 3rd, 4th and tritone
- **Direction** param adds pendulum and random modes on top
- CV out tracks the root pitch of the current step and parks at 0 V while muted
- CV in modulates density or triggers reset

#### Feel and Time
- **Shift** + fader is **Feel** — at the bottom the sequence is straight and flat; further up the off-beats swing and the dynamics open out, accenting the tonic while approach chords lighten; **Feel** steps aside when the device’s own swing is active
- Hold button and move fader for **Time** — picks step division outright across all eleven values, longest first: 1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/4t, 1/8, 1/8t, 1/16, 1/16t, 1/32, 1/32t, 1/64t
- **Division** param only sets where the app starts; the fader overrides it live

#### Motion
- **Straight** — plain engine
- **Rubato** — tonic leans, holding twice as long while ii and V keep passing
- **Sheets** — each chord becomes a fast run up and back down instead of a block
- **Free** — tritone substitutions on roughly every third dominant

#### LEDs
- Top and bottom show three distinct hues for the three tonal centers, rotated around the app colour
- Button hue sways off the current center hue with harmonic function — tonic on the center, its V a little away, its ii further still
- Button brightness rises with **Density** across the seven steps, following the CV In Density offset when that jack mode is active
- Dips briefly on each chord trigger; fades white to none when reverse toggles; flashes a colour per step when the interval cycles

channels.faderDescription: Approach depth in 7 positions on a fixed 9-slot grid — three slots (ii, V, I) per tonal center. The I of each center always plays; raising the fader inserts one approach chord at a time, first the V of centers 1–3, then the ii of centers 1–3, so the cycle grows 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 chords. Empty slots aren’t silent: the previous chord sustains through them, so the cycle stays nine slots long at every density and sparse settings give a long held tonic.

title: Axis Matrix
description: Playable Coltrane tonal center navigator - fader position, clock trigger
text:
Playable Coltrane tonal center navigator — fader position and clock trigger.

#### Faders and harmony
- **Main** positions across three centers with snap zones and approach-chord transitions at the boundaries
- **Alt** selects harmonic function at the current center: root (Maj7), dominant (Dom7) or subdominant approach (m7)
- Clock triggers the chord at the current grid position; each chord is revoiced to move as little as possible from the one before it

#### Button modes
- Tap — mutes, cutting anything still held
- Hold — drone mode: chord sustains indefinitely and updates immediately on fader movement, ignoring the clock
- **Shift** + tap — toggles latch (chord sustains until tapped again regardless of fader movement)
- **Shift** + hold — cycles **Feel** through four steps — first step straight and flat; further up off-beats swing and dynamics open out, accenting the root while approach chords lighten; **Feel** steps aside when the device’s own swing is active
- **Interval** is set in app params only — no longer cycles from the panel

#### Time fader
- Hold button and move fader for **Time** — clock division from 1/1 at the bottom down to 1/64t at the top, triplets sorted by duration rather than tacked on at the end
- **Division** param is the power-on starting point — until the fader is touched the first time it sits in the middle of that division’s zone; from then on fader position counts and is remembered with the scene

#### Sustain
- **Clock-gated** — holds each chord until the next one arrives
- **Legato** — same, but keeps the last chord ringing when the clock stops
- **Staccato** — releases every note halfway through its own step — half the chord’s step for a block chord, half the note’s slot in a **Sheets** or **Free** run

#### Motion
- **Straight** — plain engine
- **Rubato** — root chord leans, holding twice as long while dominant and subdominant keep passing
- **Sheets** — fast run up and back down instead of a block
- **Free** — tritone substitutions on roughly every third dominant
- **Drone** keeps its immediate feel and ignores the rhythmic side of **Motion**

#### LEDs
- Show current center hue, rotated around the app colour; dim as the fader drifts from center (gravitational pull)
- Button blinks when latched, stays bright when droning, flashes a colour per step when **Feel** cycles

channels.faderDescription: Selects one of three tonal centers with snap zones. Transition zones at boundaries sound approach chords.

title: Sift
description: Two-channel threshold and level sequencer
text:
Sift is a two-channel sequencer built around stored threshold patterns. Channel 1 is the gate lane and Channel 2 is the CV lane. Both lanes have ten stored patterns that can be selected independently, making it easy to keep one rhythmic structure while changing the other.

Playback follows the shared 24 PPQN transport. Gate density is sampled only at step boundaries, so changing the fader during playback does not create off-clock triggers. When a gate step passes the threshold, the gate output fires and Sift can also emit a MIDI note derived from the current CV through Faderpunk's global quantizer.

The CV lane outputs stepped voltages. Its fader chooses the number of available CV levels from a musical set: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, or 32. The CV range, polarity, minimum and maximum voltage, step counts, clock division, gate length, color, MIDI channel, and MIDI output are set from the app parameters.

#### Pattern Banks

Each lane stores ten deterministic patterns. Hold Shift and move the gate or CV lane fader to choose the active pattern for that lane. The corresponding bottom LED flashes once when the selection changes.

* **Gate pattern select:** Shift + Fader 1
* **CV pattern select:** Shift + Fader 2
* **Randomize selected patterns:** Shift + Button 1
* **Randomize all patterns:** Shift + Button 2

#### Performance Notes

* Button 1 resets both sequencer positions to the next first step.
* Button 2 mutes gate and MIDI note output. Both button LEDs dim while muted; the CV lane keeps stepping.
* Notes are released with the gate, on reset, on stop, when muted, or when a scene is loaded.
* Scenes store the pattern bank seeds, selected pattern numbers, live fader values, and mute state.
